en: Only a short comparative diagnosis is preserved for this species: it is small and pale, the antennae have 15 segments with the third 1.5 times the second, and the hind femora do not reach the abdominal apex. The head measures about 1.29 mm to the labrum tip, 1.13 mm wide, and the pronotum 0.67 mm across. No full caste description survives in the source, so no morphological account is given here. The species is known only from Jinghong, Yunnan.
